_comment: Tauri commands registered in apps/tauri/src-tauri/src/application.rs's generate_handler![...] with no invoke() caller anywhere in src/ today (architecture-hardening.md F24 / L1-2 / L2-4 gate 1). Checked by scripts/check-command-reachability.mjs. Remove an entry the moment it gets a caller (or gets deleted from Rust) — a lingering entry either way is a stale allowlist and fails the gate.
e2ee_classify_open_note: The engine's open-note disposition verb (futo_notes_sync::classify_open_note), exposed to desktop ahead of its caller. The decision is exhaustively tested in Rust and already reachable from the native shells over UniFFI; desktop's adoption is deliberately staged because reconcileSyncCompletion.ts's 14 hardened seam tests drive that path with no Rust backend, so routing a PURE decision through IPC would make them require one. Remove this entry with that adoption.
